mentions.name: Bugcloud
mentions.description: Bugcloud is a web-based debugging practice tool that presents broken front end code and lets users debug and patch it right in the browser, testing whether the fix works. Unsolved bugs come with a nice explainer popup. The goal is to level up interview code chops and build confidence debugging simpler bugs the way one would on a real production system.
mentions.problem: Technical interviews and job preparation often lack hands-on practice with real bugs, leaving candidates without the debugging skills and confidence needed for engineering roles.
mentions.audience: People in the job market preparing for front end and back end engineering interviews
mentions.source_excerpt: help prepare myself and other people in the job market with a tool that presented broken front end code, and then allow debugging on the browser and patch code right there, to test if it worked or not. if cant solve it, theres a nice explainer popup.
